note: English post has productCount 0; the two tripods are reference rows in the comparison table, listed here for EU availability and metric specs only.

productFit.name: Manfrotto MT055XPRO3 (regular reference tripod in the comparison table; not a product block)
productFit.metricSpecs: Maker (manfrotto.com global-de): 170 cm max, 140 cm with centre column down, 9 cm min, 61 cm closed, 2.5 kg, 3 leg sections.
productFit.reason: Sold in the EU under the same model code (Manfrotto German maker page; EU dealers).

productFit.name: K&F Concept 90 inch Tripod (KF09.119, T254A7+BH-28L; tall reference tripod in the comparison table; not a product block)
productFit.metricSpecs: Maker spec table (kfconcept.com): 2300 mm max, 1620 mm without centre column, 665 mm min, 540 mm folded, 2022 g, 4 leg sections, 16-25 mm legs, 10 kg load.
productFit.reason: The same ASIN is listed in the EU as the K&F Concept 230 cm tripod (T254A7+BH-28L); maker spec table gives metric figures.

localFacts.fact: CBS: Dutch-born 19-year-old men were on average 182.9 cm tall in 2020 (women 169.3 cm), so the 6 ft (183 cm) threshold of the post is the average young Dutch man.
KLM: hand baggage max. 55 x 35 x 25 cm including handles and wheels. The Manfrotto (61 cm closed) does not fit lengthwise; the K&F (54 cm folded) just fits.
Rijksmuseum: photographing and filming is allowed without disturbing others; for bridal shoots "geen statieven en geen extra belichting".
Manfrotto maker spec sheet: 170 cm max, 140 cm with the centre column down, 61 cm closed, 2.5 kg.

localPainPoints.pain: Very tall Dutch photographers need close to 2 m including hiking boots and want to stand upright without the centre column.
localPainPoints.fix: Compare legs-only height; the K&F publishes 162 cm column down.

quotes.text: Inclusief de dikke zolen van de wandelschoenen tik ikzelf bijna de 2 meter aan.

localPainPoints.pain: Tall tripods have very thin lowest leg sections, which hurts stability.
localPainPoints.fix: Keep the thinnest (16 mm) section retracted where possible, as the post advises for the K&F.

quotes.text: Bij hoge statieven zijn de onderste poten soms wel heel erg dun.

localPainPoints.pain: Tall gear that is also light is hard to find (Tweakers, 1.96 m photographer).
localPainPoints.fix: The weight trade-off section: the K&F is 2.0 kg with head, the Manfrotto 2.5 kg legs only; carbon if you hike.

quotes.text: Maar nu zijn er weinig monopods die lang en licht zijn.
